singleVisionLenses.name: VisuPro™
designFeatures: Two lifestyle-based design options: VisuPro All Day (for regular wearers with three distance types) and VisuPro Flex (for sporadic wearers with four distance types).
patientBenefits: Quicker adaptation compared to progressive lenses.
Higher satisfaction for early presbyopic symptoms.
Better adaptation to future progressive lenses.

singleVisionLenses.name: MySV®
singleVisionLenses.targetUsers: Patients needing personalized single vision lenses beyond 'one-size-fits-all'.
designFeatures: Backside free form technology compensating prescriptions in all meridians (360˚ Visual Comfort™).
Optimized base curve for larger frame selection.
patientBenefits: Wider peripheral views than standard single vision lenses.
Individualized based on position of wear measurements.
Enhanced visual acuity for all prescription powers.

singleVisionLenses.name: Sync III™
singleVisionLenses.targetUsers: Single vision patients experiencing Digital Eye Strain (DES).
designFeatures: Distance power for everyday use with a 'boost zone' in the lower portion.
Three boost zone designs: Sync III 5 (+0.57D boost), Sync III 9 (+0.95D boost), Sync III 13 (+1.32D boost).
patientBenefits: Reduced eye strain during near tasks (e.g., digital screens, reading).
Comfort on digital devices unmatched by standard single vision lenses.
Available in clear, photochromic, and polarized options.
Minimal copay difference compared to standard single vision lenses.

singleVisionLenses.name: iD Single Vision®
singleVisionLenses.targetUsers: Patients with high prescriptions needing thinner lenses and increased viewing area.
designFeatures: Bi-aspheric design using Integrated Dual Surface™ free form technology.
Expanded peripheral viewing, especially for higher prescriptions.
Requires OC and monocular PD measurements.
patientBenefits: Optimized visual acuity and crisper image perception.
Relaxed vision thanks to precise focusing.

singleVisionLenses.name: Single Vision iQ™
singleVisionLenses.targetUsers: Patients seeking PAL-level technology in single vision lenses.
designFeatures: Spherical front surface with custom back surfacing.
Backside design technology for enhanced optics.
Requires OC and monocular PD measurements.
patientBenefits: Enhanced visual acuity for all prescription powers.
Wider, clearer visual field in all directions.

keyTechnologies.name: Binocular Harmonization Technology™
keyTechnologies.description: Balances lens performance for both eyes.

keyTechnologies.name: Integrated Dual Surface™ (iD) Technology
keyTechnologies.description: Provides edge-to-edge clarity in thin lenses.

keyTechnologies.name: 360˚ Visual Comfort™
keyTechnologies.description: Compensation in all meridians for wider peripheral views.

keyTechnologies.name: Focus Max Optimization
keyTechnologies.description: Enhances close-up vision for young presbyopes.
